interpretation: AI semantic opinions, not human labels or an automatic winner. Calibration is agent-authored and limited; do not hide a failed control. Fresh sessions and metadata blinding are procedural attestations, not access isolation or statistical independence. Same-family reviewers can share bias. Agreement is descriptive across correlated rubric judgments, not an accuracy estimate. Operational failures remain separate, and product/pipeline gaps do not by themselves establish answer errors.
